_comment: Reference template for .claude/settings.json after /onboard v3.1.0 in --share mode (Skill form). Markers (_onboard_managed: true on every hook block, _onboard_managed_env_keys in env) drive /onboard --uninstall=all surgical removal — standard JSON parsers ignore unknown fields. v2.10.2 added ONBOARD_LOG_DIR so post-edit-check.sh / stop-verify.sh write their runtime logs to a mode-aware path (share = .claude/onboarding-logs; local-only = .claude/local-only/onboarding-logs); without it the share path was hardcoded and leaked into local-only working trees. Note: --share is OPT-IN as of v2.6; default mode is --local-only which uses settings.local.template.json instead. v2.11 NEW: --uninstall parameterized to [=skill|all]; in share mode hook scripts already live in-project at .claude/skills/onboard/hooks/, so =skill is a no-op-on-project (only L1 user-global gets cleaned). Replace placeholder values per project, then merge into your existing settings.json using Phase 7 deep-merge strategy (independent matcher blocks, never collapse into the same hooks array).

env._comment_ONBOARD_FORBIDDEN_COMMANDS: v2.12.0: newline-separated grep -qE regex list. Empty = no project-level command deny. Example: 'flyctl deploy.*--strategy=immediate\npsql.*DROP[[:space:]]+TABLE\nkubectl.*delete.*namespace'. Newline (NOT colon) is the separator so POSIX char classes [[:space:]] work inside patterns. Symmetric to ONBOARD_FORBIDDEN_PATHS for guard-edit (which uses colon because path values don't contain colons).
